scope: All 274 native condition-effect labels and brief summaries (548 bilingual keys), plus stock engine-condition labels and structured board/encounter duration, source, save and combat-state presentation. Authored and pack prose remains original.
provenance: Original Simplified Chinese drafts compared against repository English source; no proprietary Chinese rulebook translation used. Source licenses remain in their original files.
review: Implementation-agent bilingual comparison of every native label/summary, preserving mechanic qualifiers, timing, dice, counts, ranges, units and signed bonuses. Model tool instructions and implementation-only descriptions are omitted from player prose; engine summaries stay English. Existing spell names and rule terms reused. Numeric variants were checked individually, including all 12 Defensive Flourish values and ability/dice variants. Not independent human approval.

numericExceptions.spiritual_weapon: English 2nd is 二环 in Chinese; +1d8 per two slot levels is preserved.
numericExceptions.flame_blade: English 2nd is 二环 in Chinese; +1d6 per two slot levels is preserved.

englishGolden.capture: Captured actual English ConditionChip JSX before changing producers, source catalogs or display renderer; existing 18 compressed baselines are untouched.

terminologyReview: Compared new short-English groups against the current catalogs: Necrotic is 黯蚀; knock-out and regeneration labels match existing combat UI. Suggested has a deliberate context split: 受到暗示 for the condition, 推荐 for spell-choice advice.
